name: slimed-play-exhaust-empty-deck-seed0
description: Slimed status-card play parity: hand=[SLIMED, STRIKE_IRONCLAD], initial_energy=3, deck=[] (recorder default). Playing SLIMED (cost=1, keywords={exhaust}, effect_vars={cards:1}) costs 1 energy → energy=2, fires _draw_cards(1) on an empty draw pile + empty discard pile → no draw (no reshuffle source), Slimed exhausted → exhaust_pile_count=1, hand=[STRIKE_IRONCLAD]. Pins the exhaust-on-play + draw-side-effect contract in the empty-pile boundary where the post-play hand size shrinks by exactly 1 (the played card) rather than staying flat (1 played + 1 drawn). Sibling fixture for an actual draw resolution would require recorder draw_pile support (not yet implemented; see close reason). Pin: sts2-rl-agent@01c094d:sts2_env/cards/status.py:158-170 (slimed_effect + make_slimed). Bead sts2-rs-8z3fl.12 (follow-up to 8z3fl.11). ShrinkerBeetle is the empty-encounter sentinel.
